Marta (infra): Kicking off handoff for the new eu-south1 GPU cluster. Need SRE on-call ownership, pager config, escalation path, and a short operational run-through. Cluster is bootstrapped; validation and training next. A100 pool, 3 racks, ~120 GPUs.
Ben (sre): Thanks — quick q: what are the P1/P2 thresholds we want for paging? node failures, OOMs, throughput degradation?
Marta (infra): Initial suggestion: P1 = node down (unable to recover) OR pod OOMs >5% across service OR fabric partition affecting >10% of pods. P2 = degraded throughput >20% or queue latency 95th >250ms. I'll put formal numbers in the runbook.
Frank (oncall): I can take first-week oncall for the region. Please add me to PD and the slack rotation. I'll need a short checklist to triage quickly.
Marta (infra): PagerDuty service created: eu-south1-gpu-cluster. Config snippet: ```Service: eu-south1-gpu-cluster
Urgency: high for P1
Escalation: 0m Frank -> 10m Ben (sre lead) -> 30m Ops Manager
Routing: P1 -> page; P2 -> notify + channel alert```
infra-bot: bootstrap: eu-south1 cluster bootstrap completed (nodes provisioned: 15, GPUs: 120). Validation stage scheduled.
Ben (sre): Add a compact validation checklist to the runbook: (1) node health x3 checks (kubelet + docker + nv_peer_mem), (2) NVLink perf test, (3) KV cache warm start + smoke model load, (4) autoscaler sanity and taint/toleration checks, (5) network MTU and fabric path checks.
Marta (infra): Runbook added: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-south1-handoff — includes checklist, PD config, and incident template. Cost note added: est run-rate ~$9k/day at sustained full utilization (useful for cost-aware routing decisions).
Emily (ops): Scheduled a 30m training session Tue 09:00 UTC — invite posted. Agenda: paging playbook, triage flow, how to run the smoke tests, and rolling back node groups.
Ben (sre): Escalation path we agreed on: Frank -> Ben -> Marta -> Ops Manager. Security incidents: page sec-oncall immediately (do not wait). Ops Manager handles exec escalation.
Marta (infra): Test scenario for oncall practice: cordon 2 nodes and simulate fabric packet loss on test VLAN. Expected: autoscaler reassigns workloads within 5m; if fail -> PD P1. Logs to check: node events, kube-scheduler, inference-runtime OOM/failures, and network counters on the switch.
Frank (oncall): I'll run that test Wed AM and report results here. Also want a small "cheat sheet" for quick triage steps.
deploy-bot: validation: smoke tests passed (model loads OK). NVLink perf 98% of baseline. Queue latency 95th=120ms.
Ben (sre): Nice. Please pin the oncall checklist in #eng-oncall and create an incident template for the common failure modes (node-failure, NVLink regression, autoscaler misbehavior).
Marta (infra): Done — pinned checklist and incident template added to the runbook. If anyone needs access to PD config or runbook editing rights ping me directly. :thumbsup:
__note: This document represents a single Slack thread. Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender display names.
